summary: Enhance your financial skills with our Excel training designed for finance professionals. Master essential tools and techniques for effective data analysis.
lede: Excel training for finance professionals develops spreadsheet skills for building financial models, reports, and forecasts. It is designed for financial analysts, accountants, investment and treasury practitioners who need to turn accounting data into clear analysis. Participants practice transforming data with Power Query, linking financial statements, and using scenario tools to test assumptions and communicate results through reports and dashboards.
audienceIntro: This program is specifically curated for finance practitioners who need to elevate their technical spreadsheet capabilities to meet modern corporate standards.
modules: Financial Data Integrity and Excel Foundations
Dynamic Reporting with PivotTables and Power Pivot
prerequisites: Participants should have a foundational understanding of accounting principles, including the structure of financial statements. Basic familiarity with Microsoft Excel (entering data and simple SUM/AVERAGE formulas) is required. No prior experience with Power Query or financial modeling standards is necessary.
